Write COBOL code to read a file

```cobol
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. READFILE.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT INFILE ASSIGN TO INDD
               FILE STATUS IS WS-STATUS.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD INFILE.
       01 IN-RECORD PIC X(80).
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-STATUS PIC XX.
       01 WS-EOF PIC 9 VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           OPEN INPUT INFILE.
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF = 1
               READ INFILE
                   AT END MOVE 1 TO WS-EOF
                   NOT AT END DISPLAY IN-RECORD
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM.
           CLOSE INFILE.
           STOP RUN.
```

Write CICS code to read a VSAM file

```cobol
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. READVSAM.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-KEY     PIC X(8).
       01 WS-RECORD  PIC X(200).
       01 WS-RESP    PIC S9(8) COMP.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 'KEY00001' TO WS-KEY.
           EXEC CICS READ
               FILE('MYFILE')
               INTO(WS-RECORD)
               RIDFLD(WS-KEY)
               RESP(WS-RESP)
           END-EXEC.
           IF WS-RESP = DFHRESP(NORMAL)
               EXEC CICS SEND FROM(WS-RECORD) ERASE END-EXEC
           ELSE
               EXEC CICS SEND FROM('RECORD NOT FOUND') ERASE END-EXEC
           END-IF.
           EXEC CICS RETURN END-EXEC.
```
Write DB2 SQL in COBOL

```cobol
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. DB2QUERY.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
           EXEC SQL INCLUDE SQLCA END-EXEC.
       01 WS-EMPNO   PIC X(6).
       01 WS-NAME    PIC X(30).
       01 WS-SALARY  PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE '000010' TO WS-EMPNO.
           EXEC SQL
               SELECT FIRSTNME, SALARY
               INTO :WS-NAME, :WS-SALARY
               FROM EMP
               WHERE EMPNO = :WS-EMPNO
           END-EXEC.
           IF SQLCODE = 0
               DISPLAY 'NAME: ' WS-NAME
               DISPLAY 'SALARY: ' WS-SALARY
           ELSE
               DISPLAY 'EMPLOYEE NOT FOUND'
           END-IF.
           STOP RUN.
```

Write COBOL IF statement

```cobol
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. IFEXAMPLE.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-SCORE PIC 9(3) VALUE 85.
       01 WS-GRADE PIC X(1).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN WS-SCORE >= 90
                   MOVE 'A' TO WS-GRADE
               WHEN WS-SCORE >= 80
                   MOVE 'B' TO WS-GRADE
               WHEN WS-SCORE >= 70
                   MOVE 'C' TO WS-GRADE
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE 'F' TO WS-GRADE
           END-EVALUATE.
           DISPLAY 'GRADE: ' WS-GRADE.
           STOP RUN.
```
Write REXX loop example

```rexx
/* REXX - Loop examples */

/* DO loop */
DO i = 1 TO 10
   SAY 'Count:' i
END

/* DO WHILE loop */
count = 1
DO WHILE count <= 5
   SAY 'While count:' count
   count = count + 1
END

/* DO UNTIL loop */
num = 1
DO UNTIL num > 3
   SAY 'Until num:' num
   num = num + 1
END

EXIT 0
```

Write COBOL SEARCH example

```cobol
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. SEARCHEX.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-TABLE.
          05 WS-ENTRY OCCURS 5 TIMES
             INDEXED BY WS-IDX.
             10 WS-CODE PIC X(3).
             10 WS-DESC PIC X(20).
       01 WS-SEARCH-CODE PIC X(3).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 'ABC' TO WS-CODE(1) MOVE 'FIRST' TO WS-DESC(1).
           MOVE 'DEF' TO WS-CODE(2) MOVE 'SECOND' TO WS-DESC(2).
           MOVE 'GHI' TO WS-CODE(3) MOVE 'THIRD' TO WS-DESC(3).
           MOVE 'DEF' TO WS-SEARCH-CODE.
           SET WS-IDX TO 1.
           SEARCH WS-ENTRY
               AT END DISPLAY 'NOT FOUND'
               WHEN WS-CODE(WS-IDX) = WS-SEARCH-CODE
                   DISPLAY 'FOUND: ' WS-DESC(WS-IDX)
           END-SEARCH.
           STOP RUN.
```
